description: Department of Local Government (Western Province) - Selecting a new Vice Chairman for the Vacated Vice Chairman's Position of Katana Pradeshiya Sabha, Convened on April 12 of 2022 at 10.00 a.m.
reasoning: This gazette announces the convening of a meeting to select a new Vice Chairman for a local authority (Katana Pradeshiya Sabha). The notice is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendment, specifically concerning the electoral process for filling a vacated position in local government. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
